subject: openCR "Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : covariates must be provided for all or none"

messages.author: 91bd4367f6044e8d
messages.subject: openCR "Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : covariates must be provided for all or none"
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm having no trouble running nonspatial open models with my data but when I go to run a spatial model I get the following error: "Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : covariates must be provided for all or none." Has anyone else come across this problem?

Code below and data attached.

ebbCH <- read.capthist( captfile = "ebbCH.csv",
                          trapfile =  c( rep( "churchillTraps.txt", 10 ), "churchillTraps13.txt", 
                                         "churchillTraps.txt", "churchillNewTraps.txt" ),
                          fmt = "trapID",
                          detector = "multi",
                          covnames = 'sex')

ebbMask <- make.mask( traps = traps( ebbCH ),
                      buffer = 100,
                      type = "trapbuffer",
                      poly = land )

intervals(ebbCH) <- c(35, 28, 37, 62, 69, 83, 99, 91, 99, 125, 140, 196) / 365

summary(ebbCH)

m.array(ebbCH)

JS.counts(ebbCH)

fitspNull <- openCR.fit( ebbCH, type = 'JSSAsecrlCL', model = list( lambda0 ~ t, phi ~ t ),
                         mask = ebbMask, ncores = 3 )


Thanks,

Rebecca

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: openCR "Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : covariates must be provided for all or none"
parts: I'm guessing the error comes from the preprocessing that openCR.fit does on your multi-session input ebbCH (and that you would also get it with join(ebbCH )). I'm also guessing that the ultimate reason is an inconsistency in your trap files...
